export_controls.text:
Just as the Space Race defined a generation, the AI race will shape the future. That's why we must do all we can to ensure advanced U.S. AI chips are not sold to China or other countries of concern.

The RESTRICT Act does just that. I'm proud to join @RepGregoryMeeks in introducing this common-sense step to protect U.S. national security and AI leadership.

deepseek.reason: The speaker explicitly endorses the RESTRICT Act to prevent advanced U.S. AI chips from being sold to China and other countries of concern.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement names the bill and clearly endorses restricting advanced AI chip sales.

china_race_dynamics.text: China and our adversaries are running multiple psyop operations through American platforms in order to foment division among Americans. And it has been working.

deepseek.reason: The statement criticizes Chinese psyop operations on American platforms without addressing AI competition priorities.
deepseek.confidence_reason: It is a China-security criticism but contains no AI race or competition-policy claim.

china_race_dynamics.text: Under no circumstances should the Chinese Communist Party have access to government devices, and we can’t risk it gaining a foothold through DeepSeek. [...] I’m joining onto this commonsense, bipartisan bill to ban DeepSeek on devices issued by the federal government because we need to use every tool at our disposal to keep the CCP far away from our confidential and sensitive data.

deepseek.reason: The statement supports banning DeepSeek on federal devices for data-security reasons but does not address making AI competition with China a policy priority.
